parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station Kogam-street (Bori Metropolis). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 127 | 0.822 | 0.822
2 | 50.4 | 5.63 | 6.45
3 | 126 | 21.2 | 27.7
4 | 149 | 29.7 | 57.3
5 | 197 | - | -

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: Kogam-street (Bori Metropolis)
Curve type: HA-type
Aquifer depth: 27.7 – 57.3 m
Recommendation: Target the moderately resistive sandy layer between 27.7 m and 57.3 m for screening; ensure adequate casing and grouting through the overlying low-resistivity (50.4 Ω·m) clayey layer at 0.8–6.45 m to prevent cross-contamination and borehole collapse.
